openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing red and argue (incorrectly) that blue can leave them dead when blue is the majority, while also not demonstrating correct dominant-strategy reasoning; they never shift away from red by the end.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent commits to the red button, but their reasoning contains a fundamental rule error: they incorrectly claim that if most people choose blue, a red-presser will die. Because they believe red-pressers die when blue wins, they fail to identify red as the dominant strategy and instead treat it as a probabilistic gamble.
